It has been determined that since the commissioning date, very few charging sessions have taken place on the DC1 output of the relevant device.
Specifically, on January 26, 2025, and January 27, 2025, the recorded charging sessions were terminated by the station with the error message:
"PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_DC1_codes'"
.
We are sharing the log data in the attachment. We kindly request a detailed investigation into this issue.

Dear Yunus Emre Temel,
I apologize for the late response; we see that the faults reappeared on 2nd of Feb. We see the fault for voltage transducer:
2025-02-02T11:38:09.991062+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/1148fbf691ec[731]: PLC-Error-Flag 'HVT_TF1' changed from false - ('voltage transducer of DC1') to true - ('voltage transducer of DC1')
Here, I request you perform a site visit carrying a spare voltage transducer (part number attached), where you will have to check the wiring of the Voltage transducer (highlighted in the attached email). If the wiring is found ok, please swap the transducer and check if the fault resolves.
